finalText:
Two things usually cause this.

First, by default a child re-renders whenever its parent does, even with the exact same props. Wrapping the child in `React.memo` stops that.

Second, even with `React.memo`, if you're passing it a new object, array, or function each render, it counts as a different prop every time. Wrap those with `useMemo` or `useCallback`, or move them outside the component.

Check your child for `React.memo`, and check the props you pass for `{}`, `[]`, or inline functions built fresh each render.
